description: Derived metrics: figures computed from other metrics (a model's measures or other derived metrics), possibly across models. An operand is a metric id, or {"metric": id, "window": {...}} to pin its time window (shareOfWallet always uses the last 12 closed months), or {"sum": [operands]}. Kinds: ratio (numerator / denominator; unknown, not 0, when the denominator is 0 or missing - no credit is not 0% utilization), difference (left - right), change ((current - prior) / prior, prior = the operand over the compare window), same (the operand under a new name, usually with a pinned window).

metrics.label: Utilization
metrics.description: Drawn balance as a share of the committed limit across credit facilities. Above 0.9 on revolving lines is a warning sign.

metrics.label: Revenue (T12M)
metrics.description: Revenue over the 12 most recent closed months.

metrics.label: Share of wallet
metrics.description: Trailing-12-month revenue as a share of the client's estimated annual banking wallet.

metrics.label: Wallet gap
metrics.description: Wallet size minus trailing-12-month revenue: banking spend the client places with other banks.

metrics.label: Revenue growth (YoY)
metrics.description: Change in revenue against the same period a year earlier.

metrics.label: Win rate
metrics.description: Deals won as a share of deals closed (won or lost).

metrics.label: Fee share
metrics.description: Fee income as a share of revenue.
